title: Kingpin
description:
S01 E01 — Whitey Bulger
While the Boston underworld was in chaos in the 1970s, Whitey Bulger schemed and killed his way through the ranks to become the most famous gangster in Boston history as well as the subject of the longest manhunt in U.S. history.

title: Kingpin
description:
S01 E04 — John Gotti
In the 1980s New York, two opposing factions of the American Mafia split the Gambino crime family down the middle; the old school and the new school struggle against one another; one murderous capo emerges as the Boss of Bosses.

title: Kingpin
description:
S01 E03 — Pablo Escobar
In the 1970s in Colombia, a petty thief rises to become the most powerful criminal in history, unleashing a bloody reign of terror to create the first global drug cartel and become the first billionaire kingpin of the 20th century.

title: Mobsters
description:

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E06 — Killing Momma
An investigation into the murder of Dee Dee Blanchard, who is found face down in the bedroom of her house just outside Springfield, Mo., in June 2015.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E03 — Murder in the Kentucky Hills
Shayna Hubers calls 911 to report she has killed her boyfriend in self-defense; however, investigators soon learn he was planning a date with another woman and suspect Shayna killed him in a jealous rage.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E07 — Murder at the Mall
In 1979, 18-year-old high school student Michelle Martinko is found stabbed to death in her car in the parking lot of the Westdale Mall in Cedar Rapids, Iowa; for decades, the mystery of her murder has haunted the town and her family.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E08 — Cheerleader on Trial
High school senior Skylar Richardson tells no one of her pregnancy; however, she is charged with murder after a newborn baby's body is found buried in her family's backyard.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E04 — Murder on the Gulf Coast
When the body of former police officer Taylor Wright is discovered buried on a remote Florida farm, detectives have a lineup of suspects to investigate including her ex-husband, her new live-in girlfriend, and her best friend.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E10 — Murder in the Barnyard
Todd Mullis claimed his wife fell on a four-pronged corn rake and died; investigators found more than four holes in Amy Mullis' body; they knew her death was no accident.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E09 — The Farmer's Wife
Shirley Carter is found murdered in her farmhouse kitchen, her abusive husband, Bill, is considered a prime suspect; the husband points the finger at their son, Jason; it's left up to the jury to decide who to believe.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E21 — Deadly Compulsion
A 16-year-old girl who lives across the street from an elementary school begins shooting at students from her window; in May 2007, experts are called to investigate a bloody crime scene in Manheim Township.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E04 — Allentown Massacre & The Copycat
Brothers become neo-Nazis in Allentown, Pa.; a young student, riveted by the Allentown killings, plots a murder.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E10 — I'm So Lonesome I Could Kill & The Bicycle Thief
After a young boy is abandoned by his parents, he begins to have dark urges; a disturbing social media message leads to a murder investigation.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E03 — Frenemies & the Reject
An ex-con gets jealous when a girl grows popular in school; a youngster with a violent, alcoholic mother shows signs of being a psychopath.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E11 — No Apparent Motive
Upon visiting the home of a woman found strangled to death in a local park, police discover her family has been murdered as well.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E07 — Good vs. Evil & The Good Son
When a 16-year-old boy goes missing, suspicion falls upon the boy's girlfriend; a young couple adopts two newborn babies, but before long their boy begins exhibiting disturbing signs.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E09 — Full Metal Jacket & Mommy Issues
Four members of a family are found shot to death in Montvale, N.J.; police investigating a car accident uncover a twisted tale of teenage love and abuse that leads to the scene of a double homicide hundreds of miles away.
